'''Kevin Mulligan''' (born 23 June 1951{{cn|date=July 2025}}) is a British philosopher, working on [[ontology]], the [[philosophy of mind]], and [[Austrian philosophy]]. He is currently Honorary Professor  at the [[University of Geneva]], Full Professor at the [[University of Italian Switzerland]],<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2021|title=Professors|url=https://www.usi.ch/en/education/master/philosophy/professors|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=June 3, 2021|website=usi.ch - Master in Philosophy}}</ref> Director of Research at the Institute of Philosophy of Lugano, and member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Mulligan_Kevin|title=Academy of Europe: Mulligan Kevin|last=Hoffmann|first=Ilire Hasani, Robert|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2017-03-30}}</ref> and of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Letters, History and Antiquities|Royal Swedish Academy of Letters]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vitterhetsakad.se/ledamoter/utlandska_ledamoter|title=Kungliga Vitterhetsakademien - Ledamöter - Utländska ledamöter|website=www.vitterhetsakad.se|access-date=2017-03-30}}</ref> He is also known for his work with [[Peter Simons (academic)|Peter Simons]] and [[Barry Smith (academic)|Barry Smith]] on [[metaphysics]] and the history of [[Austrian philosophy]].

A major [[Festschrift]] on his work was published in 2014.<ref>Anne Reboul (Ed.), ''[https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9783319041988 Mind, Values, and Metaphysics. Philosophical Essays in Honor of Kevin Mulligan]'', 2 volumes, Springer</ref>

Since 2016 he is academic director and professor at the [[Università della Svizzera italiana]] in Switzerland.
